setup.error.network: The helper cannot reach app-wallee.com. Check your internet connection, firewall or proxy.
setup.error.timeout: No answer from wallee within 20 seconds. Try again later.
setup.error.invalidKey: The authentication key is not valid base64. Paste the key exactly as wallee displayed it.
